derivation: from G1 (Α) (as a negative particle) and a derivative of G1949 (ἐπιλαμβάνομαι);

occurrences.text: A bishop then must be blameless, the husband of one wife, vigilant, sober, of good behaviour, given to hospitality, apt to teach;
And these things give in charge, that they may be blameless.
That thou keep this commandment without spot, unrebukeable, until the appearing of our Lord Jesus Christ:
